name: vaultctl
description: Portable agent workflows for safe, schema-driven Markdown vault operations with vaultctl.

interface.shortDescription: Safe agent workflows for Markdown vaults.
interface.longDescription: Agent-facing workflows for vaultctl reads, one-node mutation plans and receipts, validation, drift handling, semantic merge evidence, and path-scoped Git handoff. Vault selection and authority remain consumer-owned.
defaultPrompt: Use vaultctl to inspect this Markdown vault safely.
Plan and validate a one-note vault change before applying it.
Resolve this Markdown conflict with vaultctl evidence and Git.
